newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria's forces kill three guerrillas in dormitory.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's forces kill three guerrillas in dormitory.

text.p: Algerian security forces shot dead three suspected Moslem guerrillas holed up inside Algiers main university student dormitory, an Algerian newspaper said on Tuesday.
The security forces, tipped off by students, moved over Sunday night and early Monday into Bab Ezzouar university campus, said El Watan newspaper.
The three who were killed were members of The Faithful of the Sermon guerrilla movement, said El Watan without giving further details.
The little-known group is one of several guerrilla factions in Algeria who have been fighting to overthrow the authorities.
The group issued its "communique number one" early in February in which it vowed that "Algeria's future will be more bloody and the earth will tremble under the feet of the tyrannical regime".
About 60,000 people have died in Algeria's violence since early 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election in which radical Islamists had taken a huge lead.
